user.title: Connect your smart meter
user.description: Upload the client certificate and private key registered with your utility. The Itron profile uses TLS 1.2 / CCM8 and disables server verification unless a CA is supplied. Standard uses verified TLS and requires a CA. For reconfiguration, omit uploads to retain existing files; upload a full set to replace them. TOU tiers are not automatically mapped to a tariff.

error.invalid_auth: The meter rejected the certificate or TLS connection. Check the registered certificate, key, and selected profile.
error.invalid_configuration: Check the certificate/key pair, optional CA, address, and meter response. Upload both certificate and key together. The standard profile requires a CA.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the meter. Check network access, address, and port.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The supplied address belongs to a different meter. Existing settings were preserved.
